name: Magtheridon breaks free two minutes after the Hellfire Channeler pull while the Channelers live (#8933)
contract: Magtheridon 17257 (real spawn guid 91254, map 544) is caged with UNIT_FLAG_IMMUNE_TO_PC and NOT_SELECTABLE
until his release. Pulling a Hellfire Channeler 17256 sets instance data 10 (smart_scripts 17256 id 7), which
starts the encounter and puts Magtheridon in combat with the zone. Expected, from issue #8933 and AzerothCore
PR #27600 (tested in game there: 'breaks free' at +120 s, attackable at +123 s): his self-release countdown runs
from the Channeler pull, so without killing any Channeler he becomes attackable about 123 s after the pull.
The report's failure is that the countdown never starts and he stays caged while Channelers live. The tank
enters on Channeler spawn 90978 (-55.6891, 2.17024, 0.71428; data/sql/base/db_world/creature.sql), 37 yd from
Magtheridon. set_health keeps the tank alive against the Channelers and the zone-engaged Hellfire Warders; it is
a fixture, not a damage claim. The tank's unarmed swings cannot kill a Channeler in the window; the final
assertion checks that none died, so the release came from the timer and not from the Channeler deaths.
